attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2995/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's eight Hermogenes folders is this man: they are kept on other days and none is of Akragas. The see is the page's own and unhedged and is recorded in `office`; the day before, 23 November, the same calendar keeps `gregory-of-akragas` in the same see, and the page says nothing about how the two stand to each other. The page's own name-gloss lists an Athenian philosopher, a painter and an architect of Caria as bearers of the name; that is the site's gloss on any name and nothing of it is recorded. No year, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
